title: US markets closed — Independence Day observed on Monday, July 5 (equities and USD fixed income both dark; the pre-holiday Friday 07-02 is a FULL NYSE session that also carries the SIFMA 14:00 ET bond close)
source: NEWS: three primaries, all fetched and parsed FIRST-HAND by this event's own initial research on 2026-09-09, not inherited. (1) nyse.com/markets/hours-calendars — HTTP 200 after its 302, 109,180 bytes with a browser user-agent; all 133 text cells extracted, and under the header 'Holiday | 2026 | 2027 | 2028' the Independence Day row parses exactly as 'Friday, July 3 (Independence Day observed)' / 'Monday, July 5 (Independence Day observed)' / 'Tuesday, July 4**', beneath the grid's own statement that 'All NYSE markets observe U.S. holidays as listed below for 2026, 2027, and 2028'. The same fetch's early-close footnote list names exactly three occasions across all three years — Monday July 3 2028, the day after Thanksgiving 2026/2027/2028, and Thursday December 24 2026 — so NYSE publishes NO early close on Friday 2027-07-02 and that session is a full 09:30-16:00 ET equity day. (2) sifma.org/resources/general/holiday-schedule — HTTP 200, 299,159 bytes; the 2027 US panel card decoded from the page's RSC payload reads 'U.S. Independence Day' / 'Monday, July 5, 2027' / 'Early Close (2:00 p.m. Eastern Time): Friday, July 2, 2027', so the recommended USD fixed-income tape is dark on the Monday and shortened on the Friday. (3) uscode.house.gov 5 U.S.C. 6103 — HTTP 200, 170,883 bytes. CORRECTION TO THE PROPOSAL THIS FILE SUPERSEDES: the observance does NOT follow from Section 6103, whose subsection (a) reads only 'Independence Day, July 4.' and whose subsection (b)(1) moves a SATURDAY holiday to the Friday before and says nothing about Sunday. The Sunday-to-Monday shift is Executive Order 11582, Feb. 11, 1971, 36 F.R. 2957, set out in that same page's Executive Documents section, whose Section 3(a) reads verbatim: 'Any employee whose basic workweek does not include Sunday and who would ordinarily be excused from work on a holiday falling within his basic workweek shall be excused from work on the next workday of his basic workweek whenever a holiday falls on Sunday.' That EO binds federal employees, not exchanges — the load-bearing source for the market being shut is NYSE's own grid, read first-hand above. Filed estimate on two counts, neither of which is doubt about the date: the confirmed-prefix taxonomy in market-events-data.ts has no slot for an exchange's or a trade association's own holiday calendar (the same gap labor-day-market-closure-2026-09-07, good-friday-market-closure-2027-03-26 and memorial-day-market-closure-2027-05-31 each recorded), and this lane may not self-confirm. Checked 2026-09-09
notes: Canonical file written by this event's own initial research (2026-09-09), superseding proposals/independence-day-market-closure-2027-07-05.from-sifma-bond-market-closure-2027-11-11.json — the single proposal on file, read in full first. Two of the proposer's four honest limits are now CLOSED and one is corrected: NYSE's early-close footnotes were read and name no 2027-07-02 equity early close (limit 2), and the duplicate-name check the proposer could not complete was re-run by date and by slug across every canonical file and proposal (limit 4) — nothing else claims 2027-07-05. The corrected one is the statutory mechanism (E.O. 11582 Sec. 3(a), not 5 U.S.C. 6103; see source). Still not asserted, as the proposer said: Nasdaq, CME and Treasury settlement behaviour on 2027-07-05. CALENDAR IDENTITY, verified by arithmetic 1971-2035: July 4 falls on a Sunday in exactly the years Memorial Day falls on May 31 (34 days apart is 4 weeks + 6 days), so this closure and memorial-day-market-closure-2027-05-31 are the same calendar object seen 35 days apart — 1971, 1976, 1982, 1993, 1999, 2004, 2010, 2021, 2027, 2032. That makes the sibling ledger's 8-year collision sample directly reusable here, and it is used as this ledger's control. Impact low, symbols [] — a closed session moves nothing by itself; the estimate label widens caution and licenses no entry. THE OPERATIVE DATE IS NOT THIS ONE, AND IT IS NOT THIS EVENT'S TO OWN: Friday 2027-07-02 is a full equity session carrying the SIFMA-recommended 14:00 ET bond close and the June 2027 Employment Situation. All three legs were published earlier the same day by sifma-bond-early-close-2027-07-02, which merged to main mid-session on the same primaries and a 7-of-7 payrolls derivation; this session reached the equity and payrolls legs independently (validating the BLS rule 4-of-4 against jobs-2026-09-04/10-02/11-06/12-04) and therefore DELETED the duplicate jobs-2027-07-02 proposal it had drafted rather than file a second path for one event. See that lane's proposals/jobs-2027-07-02.from-sifma-bond-early-close-2027-07-02.json.
